title: High-ranked accounts turned more constructive while onchain exposure increased
summary: Three top-quartile Smart Accounts raised their medium-term view. High-scoring Hyperliquid wallets also added net long exposure.
conclusion: The social view and observable capital are moving in the same direction. This is stronger than a discussion-volume spike, but price is already above your cost basis and the signal should be monitored for follow-through.
positionImpact: Your NVDA position is 35% of this sample portfolio. Avoid treating the confirmation as an automatic add signal; watch whether net long exposure persists after the next session.
nextStep: Compare the next two sessions of high-score wallet exposure with whether the three semiconductor authors maintain their upgraded view.

evidence.title: Net long exposure increased

title: Social optimism is rising without matching capital confirmation
summary: Positive creator commentary accelerated, while high-scoring onchain accounts reduced aggregate exposure over the same window.
conclusion: The disagreement does not prove an immediate reversal, but it raises the risk that social momentum is running ahead of observable capital. A second day of outflows would make the divergence more meaningful.
positionImpact: HOOD is below your average cost and represents 28% of this portfolio. Prioritize downside risk review before increasing exposure.
nextStep: Review whether public long exposure continues to fall and identify which bullish assumptions would be invalidated by the next operating update.

evidence.title: High-scoring wallets reduced exposure

title: A new long-horizon thesis appeared from a high-ranked software investor
summary: A top-decile Smart Account published its first actionable PLTR view in six months, focused on commercial operating leverage.
conclusion: This is a new source of evidence rather than market-wide confirmation. Its value is the author's software track record and explicit twelve-month horizon.
positionImpact: Your PLTR position is profitable and smaller than NVDA. Add the thesis to research, but wait for independent evidence before changing position size.
nextStep: Track whether another independent software specialist adopts the same twelve-month thesis and whether public positioning leaves its current neutral range.

evidence.detail: The author ranks in the top decile for software calls and had not covered PLTR during the prior 180 days.

evidence.title: Thesis centers on operating leverage
evidence.detail: The opinion cites commercial growth and margin expansion rather than short-term price momentum.

title: A high-ranked account revised its MSTR risk framework
summary: A top-quartile crypto-equity specialist kept a constructive long-horizon view but raised the price level that would invalidate the thesis.
conclusion: The thesis remains constructive, but the tighter invalidation level indicates less tolerance for a Bitcoin-led drawdown. This is an author view change, not a capital-confirmed signal.
positionImpact: MSTR represents a smaller position in this sample portfolio, but its volatility can make its risk contribution larger than its market-value weight suggests.
nextStep: Read the revised invalidation conditions and compare them with MSTR's Bitcoin sensitivity before deciding whether the thesis still matches your holding horizon.

evidence.title: Risk framework changed
evidence.detail: The author remains constructive over twelve months but moved the invalidation threshold closer to the current price.

evidence.title: Volatility remains elevated
evidence.detail: Recent MSTR realized volatility remains materially above the broader software and financial sectors.
